title: fix(core)!: a platform object exposing delete is no longer annotated restore/purge, and the recycle-bin texts say the bin exists
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93koVFxhFV4XSN9LDjNtxEf)_
Fixes #31629

Clause-②: no (narrowing). Measured on base ad622d30 and head c272ca86: on base, a `sys_` / `cloud_` / `ai_` object exposing `delete` is annotated `restore` and `purge` (3 of the 4 new pins red); on head it is not, and a business object keeps both (pins green). The doors are unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: `skills/**` never names the effective `apiOperations` annotation, and `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` already describes the recycle bin as taking business-object rows, so no skill text changes. `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:414` belongs to #30847 and is untouched.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台对象（`sys_`/`cloud_`/`ai_`）开放 `delete` 时，有效权限里的 `apiOperations` 注解不再列出 `restore`/`purge`；业务对象照旧。另外 spec 和 core 里六处说“没有回收站”的文字改成真话。
- 为什么改：回收站按 ADR-0148 D5 不收平台对象，门本来就拒绝（404/400），注解却说可以，界面会给出点了必失败的按钮；文字也误导作者和 AI。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄一个计算出来的注解，门的答复逐字节不变；平台对象开放 `delete` 时现在总会带注解（与外部只读数据源同一规则）。回滚就是回退本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` 的 `annotateEffectiveApiOperations`（`noRecycleBin` 那一行）；`effective-object-permissions.test.ts` 的 `[#31629]` 块；`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` 三段提示文字。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts -t 31629`，预期 4 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**N1, the annotation (core).** `annotateEffectiveApiOperations` now withholds `restore` and `purge` from an object where `hasPlatformObjectPrefix(obj)` holds. The recycle bin takes no object in the platform namespaces (ADR-0148 D5), and the derivation table is a pure function of `enable` that never sees the object's name, so the refusal is folded at the annotation, the same way the external write gate is (#30370). A platform object that exposes `delete` is therefore always annotated, because it is served less than its derived closure. Every other operation it lists is unchanged. A business object keeps `restore` and `purge` exactly as before.

**The doors are unchanged (门未改).** No file under `packages/objectql` or `packages/rest` is in the diff, and no server path reads `apiOperations` for enforcement (`git grep apiOperations` outside tests and spec finds only a docblock in plugin-hono-server). On a platform object a restore or purge of an entry still answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and a list, an empty or a permanent delete still answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. There is no 405.

**`packages/spec/src/data/api-derivation.ts`:** one docblock clause on `API_METHOD_DERIVATION`: a platform object has no bin, its bin doors refuse whatever `apiMethods` says, and the annotation withholds the two verbs there.

**N2, the texts.** Each now says the recycle bin exists for business objects and why platform objects have none:

- `object.zod.ts` `LEGACY_API_METHOD_GUIDANCE.restore` / `.purge` (printed by the strip warning): "declare ['delete'], `restore` / `purge` derives from delete", in place of "never derives … soft-delete work is parked".
- `object.zod.ts` `CAPABILITIES_RETIRED_KEY_GUIDANCE.trash` (claim amendment 6735175859): no longer says soft delete is parked.
- `object.zod.ts` the `softDelete` tombstone: no longer says there is no soft-delete or recycle-bin runtime.
- `webhook.zod.ts` the `undelete` note: the engine now has a restore that publishes `data.record.restored`, and no webhook trigger maps it yet.
- `effective-object-permissions.ts` the `EXTERNAL_WRITE_GATED_OPERATIONS` docblock: `restore` / `purge` derive from `delete`, in place of "never derive today".
- `connector.zod.ts:191-194`, a code comment (claim amendment 6735175859): no longer says every delete is a hard delete.

**Deliberately unchanged:** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.audit-log-action-restore-retired.ts`. It is the dated record of a past retirement and its text was true when it shipped (seat ruling, claim amendment 6735175859). CHANGELOG history is untouched.

## Tests

- New top-level `describe('[#31629] …')` in `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts`, 4 cases: an unrestricted platform object is annotated without `restore` / `purge` while a business object keeps both (CONTROL); a platform object that would otherwise need no annotation is annotated; an `apiMethods` subset with `delete` loses the two verbs on a platform object only; a platform object without `delete`, or with its API closed, is annotated as before.
- **Forced test edits**, all in `packages/spec/src/data/object.test.ts`, each pinning the corrected sentence in place of the false one: line 92 (`trash` guidance, named by the claim amendment), line 1314 (`softDelete` tombstone needle `hard deletes`), and lines 2707-2713 (the `restore` / `purge` strip guidance).

<details><summary>Step 0 on base ad622d30: the pin, red</summary>

```
× an unrestricted platform object is annotated without restore / purge; a business object keeps both (CONTROL)
× a platform object that would otherwise need no annotation is annotated, so the client offers no bin door
× an apiMethods subset that includes delete loses restore / purge on a platform object only
Tests  3 failed | 1 passed | 55 skipped (59)
```

| object | `enable` | annotation on base | annotation on head | door (files byte-identical on base and head) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `sys_widget` | default | `… search, restore, purge, import` | `… search, import` | restore/purge entry `404`, list/empty/permanent `400` |
| `cloud_widget` | `apiMethods: [get, list, delete]` | `get, list, delete, aggregate, search, restore, purge` | `get, list, delete, aggregate, search` | same |
| `crm_widget` (CONTROL) | default | `… restore, purge, import` | unchanged | serves the bin |

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the platform-prefix fold removed, pins red, restored</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the line `&& !(noRecycleBin && RECYCLE_BIN_OPERATIONS.has(operation)));` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 84d154a8 → 91593f6c) and ran the core file: `Tests  3 failed | 56 passed (59)`, the three `[#31629]` cases. Restored: blob after restore 84d154a8 = blob at HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject is imported from `src` relatively, so no build sat between mutation and run.

</details>

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

- core full suite on d07a0cd6 (core unchanged since): `Test Files 139 passed (139)`, `Tests 3198 passed (3198)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck` exit 0.
- spec full suite on c272ca86: `Test Files 826 passed | 1 skipped (827)`, `Tests 26126 passed | 1 skipped | 1 todo`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0; `check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- consumers of the map: plugin-hono-server `effective-api-operations.test.ts` + `current-user-endpoints-effective-objects.test.ts` 36/36; plugin-security `get-effective-object-permissions.test.ts` 68/68.
- door CONTROL at head: objectql `recycle-bin/{list,purge,restore,capture}.test.ts` 141/141 (includes "refuses a platform object, 400"); rest `recycle-bin-routes.test.ts` 33/33 (includes the two 404s).
- full dogfood on d07a0cd6: `Test Files 441 passed | 3 skipped (444)`, `Tests 3662 passed | 42 skipped`. The final head differs from d07a0cd6 by a code comment in `connector.zod.ts` and the three spec test pins only.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over the seven touched source and test files: exit 0 (core and spec declare no `lint` script).

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates on c272ca86</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 90 commands; all 90 ran on c272ca86 and exited 0. Reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 90 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 90 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. Two first attempts exited 3 for prerequisites, not findings, and were re-run green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone, deepened) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needed a full `pnpm build`); five spec dist readers (`check:api-surface`, `check:browser-reachable-entries`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`) were re-run after a spec rebuild on c272ca86. `check:nul-bytes` exit 0. Note: the derivation flagged two gate scripts changed on origin/main since the merge base (`check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`, `platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs`); the local run read the base copies, and CI runs the merge ref.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- After this PR, a full grep of `packages/spec/src` and `packages/core/src` (migration and conversion entries excluded, per the seat's ruling) for the "no recycle bin" sentence family finds only true statements: a platform object has no bin, a composition may register none, and the bin did not exist before ADR-0148 (past tense).

```
git grep -n -i -E "no (soft-delete|recycle.bin)|never derive[s]? (today|\()|soft-delete work is parked|soft delete is parked|no restore (capability|operation)|recycle-bin runtime|deletes are hard deletes|every delete is a hard delete|neither built yet" HEAD -- packages/spec/src packages/core/src ':!packages/spec/src/migrations/**' ':!packages/spec/src/conversions/**'
```

Six hits, all true: the two `[#31629]` lines (a platform object has no bin), `protocol.zod.ts:3222` (a composition with no recycle bin), `webhook.test.ts:18` and `api-derivation.ts:137` (past tense), and the corrected `softDelete` tombstone (past tense).

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts -t 31629`: 4 passed.
